notes: barcode labels of an item lot (BARCODE_LABELS.fmx): store, group, item, unit, lot (required, 'مسلسل النظام'), number of labels and price (default = reduction price, else wholesale for DEAL_TYPE 1, else retail); the print button empties the work table PRINT_TRNS_BARCODE and fills one row per label (item English name, barcode = alternative number PEICE_NO or item code, price, user) for report ST_BARCODE_LABEL (printed by the report engine)

proc.description_a: طباعة باركود صنف: اختر المخزن والصنف والوحدة ومسلسل النظام (الشحنة) وعدد الملصقات، ويمكن تعديل سعر البيع (الافتراضي حسب نوع تعامل المخزن). عند الضغط على تجهيز الملصقات تُملأ ملصقات تقرير الباركود ST_BARCODE_LABEL ويظهر محتواها في الجدول أدناه.
proc.description_e: Item barcode labels: choose the store, the item, the unit, the system serial (lot) and the number of labels; the selling price defaults from the store deal type. Prepare labels fills the labels of report ST_BARCODE_LABEL, listed below.

params.name: STORE_CODE
params.lov_sql: select s.store_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 order by s.store_code

params.name: GROUP_CODE
params.lov_sql: select g.item_group_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(g.name_e, g.name_a), g.name_a) d, g.item_group_code r from st_item_group g order by g.item_group_code

params.name: ITEM_CODE
params.lov_sql: select i.item_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a), i.name_a) d, i.item_code r from st_item i where nvl(i.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or i.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by i.item_code

params.name: UNIT_CODE
params.lov_sql: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(u.name_e, u.name_a), u.name_a) d, u.unit_code r from st_unit u order by u.unit_code

params.name: ITEM_CONFG_ID
params.lov_sql: select c.item_confg_id || ' - ' || c.item_code || ' - ' || c.lot_number || ' - ' || to_char(c.expire_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') d, c.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg c order by c.item_code, c.item_confg_id

proc.preview_sql: select p.item_serial, p.item_code, p.item_name, p.barcode, p.sales_price, p.user_code from print_trns_barcode p order by p.item_code, p.item_serial
